sources.title: Fastrac Series 4000 and 8000 Technical Data — 4160, 4190, 4220, 8290, 8330
sources.applicability: The current live JCB 8000-series page is the landing authority. Static dimensions, suspension cylinder size, selected tire basis, transmission, capacities, 540E/1000 PTO modes, steering topology, and linkage presentation context were transcribed from JCB's eight-page 2022 French technical-data publication while its direct asset URL was live; that direct asset now returns 404 and is retained only as a retired-official-asset locator. Its 335/348 hp calibration is not applied to the US power facts, and no Category 3N fact or geometry is claimed in the public package.
